cells.requirement: All 1 to 4 unit residential properties are exempt from Jersey City's rent control regulations.

The FAIR Act prohibits residential rental property owners and software providers from using algorithmic revenue management software that collects or processes competitors' nonpublic leasing information to set or recommend rental prices or coordinate pricing.
Housing providers are prohibited from inquiring about or considering an applicant's criminal record prior to issuing a conditional offer of rental housing, with limited exceptions.
Landlords and their agents cannot charge a residential rental application or screening fee exceeding $50, subject to annual CPI adjustments.
Landlords are prohibited from charging a security deposit exceeding one and one-half times one month's rent, and must return the deposit within 30 days after the termination of a tenancy.
Newly constructed multiple dwellings are exempt from local rent control ordinances for a period of 30 years following completion of construction.
